proper_noun_moves.baseline_rule: pre-repair: capitalised, non-initial, all nearest capitalised or absent

measurement.adjudicated_by: Astra by eye against the transcript, 2026-09-12
measurement.projected_note: arithmetic: 0.60 x 175 candidates, not a measurement
measurement.statement: PROVISIONAL labels whose precision is estimated from 20 adjudicated items, not verified individually.
measurement.statement_timing: The 0.60 precision was measured BEFORE the last two repairs (morphological proper-noun and acronym scopes, unmarked carry/cut detection); those repairs removed artefacts only, so it is a FLOOR, not an estimate.

main_sample.population: scope == non_word after the carry/clip/morpheme repair
main_sample.verdict: Main/Astra, 2026-09-12: 12/20 genuine pupil errors, 7 artefacts, 1 ambiguous - precision 0.60 (95% CI 0.39-0.81). Per-item reasons: eval/runs/notebook_v1/sample3_adjudication.json

sample_history.population: scope == non_word after the clip/cell repair
sample_history.verdict: Main, 2026-09-12: ~3 of 20 plausible pupil errors; 17 were structural artefacts in 4 families - carry leaks (заня/ложения/ский/ет), morpheme drills in parentheses/hyphens, dotless phonetic abbreviations, and teacher-filled brackets.

page34_comparison.match_rule: candidate (line, written) vs record (line, written); both normalised NFC + ё→е + lowercase with '-' removed (the carry join drops the line-break hyphen, so 'виб-ретто' matches 'вибретто')

missed.why_not_found: pymorphy3 knows the written form, so a lexicon pass cannot flag it
